title: Add the <search> element

labels.name: impacts documentation
labels.description: Used by documentation communities, such as MDN, to track changes that impact documentation

body:
Closes #5811. ### Mini-explainer This new element allows authors to express the semantics of "a set of form controls or other content related to performing a search or filtering operation". This is an especially desired semantic because it is something that an ARIA landmark role exists for (`role="search"`), but today can only be expressed with ARIA. Adding a dedicated element allows authors to follow the [first rule of ARIA](https://w3c.github.io/using-aria/#rule1) (~ "don't use ARIA if you can avoid it") and is part of the [co-evolution process](https://w3c.github.io/aria/#co-evolution) between ARIA and HTML. Please see [the pull request preview](https://whatpr.org/html/7320/grouping-content.html#the-search-element) for web-developer focused details on usage and examples. Some notable design choices: - The name. We were initially a bit concerned that developers would think that this was a type of search input, not a search container. Although we briefly discussed alternative names to combat this like ``, ``, ``, ``, they each had problems, and a quick [Twitter poll](https://twitter.com/domenic/status/1437891692926017537) helped seal the deal that developers would expect and prefer the name ``. (In addition to other developers chiming in with reasoning on the thread.) See the comments starting at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5811#issuecomment-916489175 for more details. - Like other "block-level" elements, `` closes any open `

` tags. This ensures an easy transition path from `

` to `` and maintains platform consistency. - Like other "block-level" elements, the user-agent stylesheet for `` makes it `display: block` and `unicode-bidi: isolate`. - For conformance-checker purposes, the element is categorized as flow content and palpable content, but not sectioning content. (In this respect, it is categorized similarly to `
`, but not like `
` or `
`.) We are not sure whether this is ideal, partly because due to #83 sectioning content is a tricky category. But we believe that the main effect of sectioning content is to encourage authors to add headings inside the sections, which is perhaps not the right default here? - This element is a straightforward replacement for `
`, and does not come with any additional functionality (such as having form-submission capabilities). Instead it can be combined with other primitives such as `
`, or JavaScript, etc. You can see extensive discussion of this in #5811. The reasons for disfavoring more complex solutions are [implementer-expressed considerations about complexity and compat risk](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5811#issuecomment-1012650363), as well as [web-developer and accessibility community preferences](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5811#issuecomment-981747584). ### Credits The element description and examples is almost entirely written by @scottaohara, although I made a few edits and rearrangements. ### PR merge checklist - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium is interested * Gecko: positive: https://github.com/mozilla/standards-positions/issues/610 - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * Parser: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/39158 * Rendering: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/39163 * Perhaps the conformance checker test suite should also be updated, /cc @sideshowbarker. - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chrome: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1294294 * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1824121 * Safari: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=254327 * Validator.nu: https://github.com/validator/validator/issues/1569 - [x] Dependent specs are ready to update: - [x] https://github.com/w3c/html-aria/pull/401 - [x] https://github.com/w3c/html-aam/pull/355 - [x] MDN issue filed: https://github.com/mdn/mdn/issues/385 (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** /dom.html ( diff ) /grouping-content.html ( diff ) /index.html ( diff ) /indices.html ( diff ) /parsing.html ( diff ) /rendering.html ( diff ) /syntax.html ( diff )
